title: Set up a Power Platform environment strategy for Copilot Studio agents
problem: Makers build agents in the default environment with no governance.
steps: Define environments: Default (personal productivity), Dev/Test/Prod for shared agents.
Turn on environment routing in the Power Platform admin center to send new makers to their own personal developer environment.
Restrict who can create environments in Power Platform admin center.
pitfalls: Leaving the default environment wide open is the most common mistake.
Environment routing is a premium (Managed Environments) governance feature and the routed developer environments are managed.
done_when: Your environment strategy (Default vs Dev/Test/Prod) is written down.
Environment routing is on and environment creation is restricted to named admins.
